question: I need my Canadian credit history before renting. Which two main credit bureaus provide free reports, and will checking my own report lower my credit score?
generated_answer: Yes, you can obtain your Canadian credit history for free from two main credit bureaus: Equifax and TransUnion. Checking your own credit report will not lower your credit score. In fact, it's a good practice to regularly review your credit report to ensure its accuracy and to identify any potential issues. You can request a free copy of your credit report from each bureau once a year. If you need to check more frequently, you may need to pay a small fee. Remember, monitoring your credit report can help you make informed financial decisions and improve your credit health over time.
